pagerbot: :rotating_light: PD P12345 fired: inference-gateway us-west1 5xx-rate spike > 12% over 3m. automatic page to #incidents
incident-bot: Autopager details: group=inference-gateway, signal=5xx_rate, window=3m, threshold=10%. Links: https://observability/redwood/p/alerts/P12345
Aisha: acked. taking lead — oncall handoff to me.
Reza: +1 sitting with Aisha. initial checks: are errors 502 or 5xx mix? any region skew?
Kavya: looking at dashboard — primarily 502/503 from backend upstream. top route: `POST /v1/infer` (token gen). QPS normal but error rate up.
Jordan: I see concurrent KV cache evictions around same time, and a flurry of grpc keepalive resets from the serving pool logs. suspect backpressure.
Aisha: ok. mitigation plan: 1) divert traffic off risky model variant, 2) scale dedicated pool by +2 nodes, 3) enable fallback routing to smaller model. Reza, can you trigger scale?
Reza: scaling dedicated-usw2-pool by 2 now. ETA ~90s. `kubectl -n inference scale deployment gpu-serving --replicas=12`
Kavya: posting customer impact note to #support: "We are investigating transient 5xx errors impacting text generation in us-west1; some requests may see failures or retries. Working on mitigations." :memo:
Jordan: running quick query to validate: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway",status=~"5.."}[1m])) by (region)` returns spike in us-west1 only.
Aisha: routing change in flight: switch traffic for model redwood/llama-3-large -> redwood/llama-3-small canary. Doing gradual 30% shift to fallback.
Reza: scale finished, pool reports healthy. starting draining of the most recent nodes that exhibited keepalive errors.
incident-bot: Note: canary rollback policy set: if 5xx_rate > 5% for 2m, revert.
Kavya: error rate dropping to ~3% after routing shift. support notified to pause outbound customer alerts.
Jordan: still seeing occasional 502s, but KV cache storm subsided after scale + draining.
Aisha: continuing to monitor. next actions: follow-up postmortem, add a smoke test to catch kvcache eviction pattern, and review keepalive settings. tagging @platform for follow-up.
Reza: prepping short runbook patch: increase grpc keepalive timeout, add circuit-swap threshold.
Kavya: will update support thread: "Issue mitigated; normalized error rates observed after traffic shift and cluster scale. Monitoring for stabilization."
Aisha: marking incident as mitigated at `1750101380`. leaving a 30m watch. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: PD P12345 auto-close condition met? manual close required by oncall.
